items.title: 2.5.3.1 Module Search Path and Package Structure (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the module search path and packages (PDF 49-50).

blocks.text: Jab aap koi module import karte hain to Python usay ek khaas order (tarteeb) mein dhoondti hai. Aayiye har step aasan misaal se dekhein.
1. Current directory (abhi wala folder): Python sab se pehle us folder mein dekhti hai jahan aap ka script rakha hai. Farz karein aap ke folder mein main.py script aur helper.py module dono hain.
Misaal: helper.py mein:

def greet () :
    return " As – Salaam Alaikum from helper.py!"

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh helper.py naam ki file (module) ka code hai.
"def greet () :": greet naam ka function banta hai jo koi parameter nahi leta.
"return " As – Salaam Alaikum from helper.py!"": ek string wapas karta hai. Kitab ke text mein shuru mein ek space aur lamba dash (–) hai, woh bhi string ka hissa hai.
Output: yeh file akeli chalayein to kuch print nahi hota, kyun ke function sirf define hua hai, call nahi. Isay doosri file (main.py) import kar ke istemal karti hai.
main.py mein:

import helper
message = helper.greet()
print(message) # Output : As - Salaam-Alaikum from helper.py!

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh main.py ka code hai, jo helper.py ko istemal karta hai.
"import helper": usi folder mein rakhi helper.py ko module ke taur par laata hai (.py likhe baghair).
"message = helper.greet()": helper module ka greet() function call hota hai aur us ki string message mein aati hai.
"print(message)": woh string print hoti hai.
Akela chalane par (helper.py usi folder mein na ho) ModuleNotFoundError aata hai, is liye yeh website par akela nahi chal sakta.
Output: dono files saath hon to helper.py wali string chhapti hai: " As – Salaam Alaikum from helper.py!" (shuru mein space aur lamba dash). Comment ka "As - Salaam-Alaikum from helper.py!" is se thora mukhtalif hai.

2. Standard library: current folder mein module na mile to Python standard library mein dekhti hai, jis mein bohat se built-in modules hain. Maslan random numbers ke liye standard library ka random module. (Kitab is step ko bhi "1." number deti hai.)
Misaal: main.py mein:

import random
number = random.randint(1, 10)
print(f"Random number: {number}")  # ‘f’ is used to place the value of a variable in a string
# Output:
# Random number:  7 (or any number between 1 and 10)

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
"import random": random Python ki standard library ka hissa hai, is liye alag file ki zaroorat nahi.
"number = random.randint(1, 10)": 1 se 10 tak (dono shamil) koi number chunta hai.
"print(f"Random number: {number}")": f-string mein { } ke andar variable ki value aa jati hai.
"# Output:" wali lines sirf comments hain.
Output: "Random number: " ke baad 1 se 10 tak koi number, har Run par alag ho sakta hai. Comment mein colon ke baad do spaces dikhaye gaye hain, asal output mein sirf ek space hota hai (maslan "Random number: 7").
Package structure

Bare projects mein modules ko packages mein rakha jata hai. Package bas ek folder hai jis mein milte julte modules hon. Maslan e-commerce (online dukaan) platform ke liye ecommerce naam ka package, jis mein products.py, customers.py aur orders.py modules hon.
Misaal: ecommerce/products.py mein:

def list_products () :
    return ["Laptop","Mobile", "Tablet"]

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh ecommerce folder (package) ke andar products.py file (module) ka code hai.
"def list_products () :": list_products naam ka function banta hai.
"return ["Laptop","Mobile", "Tablet"]": teen products ki list wapas karta hai.
Output: yeh file akeli kuch print nahi karti; function sirf define hota hai. Main script isay import kar ke call karti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab function ka naam 1ist_products chhapti hai, yani shuru mein digit 1. Naam digit se shuru nahi ho sakta (SyntaxError), aur main script list_products() bulata hai. Sahi: def list_products():
Main script mein:

from ecommerce import products
available_products = products.list_products()
print(available_products)
#    Output :
#    ['Laptop', 'Mobile', 'Tablet']

blocks.title: Code Explanation (Wazahat)
blocks.text:
Yeh main script ka code hai jo ecommerce package ko istemal karta hai.
"from ecommerce import products": ecommerce folder ke andar se products module laata hai.
"available_products = products.list_products()": function call; list available_products mein aati hai.
"print(available_products)": list ko brackets aur single quotes samet print karta hai.
"# Output :" wali lines sirf comments hain.
Akela chalane par (ecommerce folder aur products.py maujood na hon) ModuleNotFoundError aata hai, is liye yeh website par akela nahi chal sakta.
Output: dono files sahi jagah hon to ['Laptop', 'Mobile', 'Tablet'].

blocks.title: Tidbits
blocks.text: Modules ko packages mein rakhna aisa hai jaise library mein kitabein alag alag hisson mein rakhna: code dhoondna aur sambhalna aasan ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt: import helper likhne par Python sab se pehle kahan dhoondti hai?
blocks.explanation: Chalne wale script ke current folder mein; wahan na mile to standard library mein.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Python pehle current folder, phir standard library mein module dhoondti hai.
Package: modules ka folder; from package import module.
